title: Electronic invoicing and e-reporting (France)
description: Select when billing or checkout software of a company established in France invoices businesses liable to French VAT, sells to individuals or operators abroad, or collects VAT on receipt of payment; it is not preselected for a sector, since any sector can bill. It adds the platforms, formats, new invoice mentions and e-reporting of the French reform to vat-and-e-invoicing, which keeps the VAT rules and the dates.
